[EN] Join the Counterintelligence Corps, see the world, they said.

Meet interesting people, then kill them, they said.

The didn't say nothing about being a glorified errand-runner...without the glory.
[ES] Únete al Cuerpo de Contrainteligencia, ve el mundo, decían.

Conoce gente interesante y luego mátala, decían.

No dijeron nada sobre ser un simple mandadero glorificado... sin la gloria.
